bundle_metadata_parity: the attention-item degraded foil now carries the same style of unique item/side metadata tag as every transcode, so no bundle video is distinguishable by presence or absence of container metadata; bundle rebuilt before any distribution
integrity_bindings_freeze: both the QC tool and the analyzer must verify the supplied power artifact against bundle-manifest.json power_sha256, validate its schema, and require its usable_judgment_target to equal the schedules' pinned target; mismatches are hard errors
regression_coverage: tests/test_taew21_study_tools.py pins: altered-power rejection, out-of-order and unnecessary replacement rejection, under-target no-authority verdict, target-based GO verdict, bundle digest uniqueness with zero reference/option equality, and attention-candidate metadata parity

stopping_rule_freeze.enforcement: the blinded QC tool reports policy_violations mid-collection; the response analyzer refuses authoritative analysis (hard error) on any of: replacements present before all 30 primaries responded, replacements not forming a contiguous ID-ordered prefix of R30-R35, or any replacement activated when usable judgments from prior participants already met the target
stopping_rule_freeze.power_simulation_note: the frozen simulation models 30 primaries with ~10% exclusion and no replacement (expected usable 486.4); target-based stopping delivers at least 486 usable judgments whenever it completes, so the simulated pass probability at chance (0.7485) is a mild lower-bound approximation for the executed design; the simulation is NOT rerun and its artifact digest above remains authoritative
stopping_rule_freeze.rejected_alternative: one-for-one replacement seeking 30 included participants (up to 540 judgments) - rejected because the protocol's frozen stopping rule is stop-at-simulation-fixed-usable-judgment-target-no-sequential-peeking
stopping_rule_freeze.rule: the primary cohort is fixed at 30 participants P00-P29 and is always collected in full; replacement participants R30-R35 are activated strictly one at a time in ID order, and a replacement may be activated ONLY while usable study judgments from all previously collected participants remain below the frozen target of 486; collection stops at the first count >= 486; if all six replacements are exhausted below target the study returns no-authority-insufficient-usable-judgments

title: Stopping-rule interpretation freeze, replacement enforcement, bundle metadata parity, regression coverage
